GW2 Companion Bridge for Windows x64
====================================

1. Extract the entire ZIP to a normal folder.
2. Start Guild Wars 2 and enter the world.
3. Double-click GW2Bridge.exe. Allow private-network access if Windows asks.
4. Keep the console window open. After this update, scan its QR code once in the
   iPhone app. Future bridge restarts reuse the same protected pairing token.

If the iPhone says PAIR AGAIN, close the bridge and run this in PowerShell from
the extracted folder, then scan the new QR code:

    .\GW2Bridge.exe --reset-pairing

Useful options:

    .\GW2Bridge.exe --simulate
    .\GW2Bridge.exe --port 40000
    .\GW2Bridge.exe --mumble-name NAME

The bridge must run as the same Windows user and at the same elevation level as
Guild Wars 2. Remove the game's "-mumble 0" option because it disables
MumbleLink. The default private-network firewall port is TCP 38291.

The pairing secret is protected for the current Windows user under local
application data. Deleting that data or using --reset-pairing requires pairing
the phone again.
